justification: The avatar is a grounded inhabitant of the world, not a free-flying camera: only the two ground-plane axes are permitted. ZQSD drives forward/strafe on the plane; the vertical axis is DENIED, so no input can lift the body off the ground — you cannot fly. Piloting is a gated bounded-intent projection: only a `granted` control over the bound Actor turns input into motion, clamped to max_tick_displacement per applied delta so a stalled frame cannot teleport the body. Any axis the contract does NOT permit is refused, never treated as a permitted default — the gate, not the input, decides motion.
